title: Contaminated Water Signs
description: Visual, smell, and taste warning signs of contaminated water, including fuel, chemicals, and toxic algae. Explains boil-water, do-not-drink, and do-not-use advisories, risks after floods and other disasters, and which treatment fits each problem.
shortDescription: Warning signs, toxic algae, boil vs do-not-drink notices, and flooded wells
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
